description:
Promotional Rent Offer: £1,256 pcm. A landlord-funded incentive of £1,884, equivalent to six weeks’ rent free, is included with this offer. When averaged over a 12-month tenancy, this gives an effective rental cost of £1,099 pcm. The contractual rent remains £1,256 pcm as stated in the tenancy agreement. The incentive will be applied as a rental credit to your resident account during the second month of your tenancy, reducing the amount payable during months three and four. The security deposit is five weeks’ rent, approximately £1,449.23.

The Holloway offers contemporary city living in a prime Birmingham location, combining stylish apartments with an excellent selection of resident amenities. The development is pet-friendly, making it ideal for those wanting to enjoy central living with their four-legged companions.

Residents can make use of a fully equipped gym, 24-hour concierge, work-from-home spaces, residents’ lounges and two roof terraces. The 10th-floor BBQ areas provide an impressive setting for relaxing and enjoying panoramic city views, while a private dining room and residents’ bar offer additional spaces to socialise and entertain.

Located between Birmingham New Street Station and The Mailbox, The Holloway puts the best of Birmingham within easy reach. The canalside, Bullring, restaurants, bars, entertainment and cultural attractions are all nearby, with New Street Station approximately a 13-minute walk away.

Everyday convenience is also covered, with parcel collection lockers and 150Mb Hyperoptic Wi-Fi included each month, with faster speeds available to upgrade to if required.

Offering a central location, modern facilities, excellent connectivity and a pet-friendly environment, The Holloway is an ideal choice for comfortable, connected Birmingham living.

Living Area - Open plan living area, with sofa, media unit and access to the outdoor terrace

Kitchen - Fully-integrated kitchen with induction hob, full sized fridge/freezer & full sized dishwasher

Bedroom - Large double bedroom with floor to ceiling window

Bathroom - Modern bathroom with shower over the bath

Communal Areas - 24-hour concierge, gym, lounges, roof terraces, workspaces, bookable rooms and more

Contact us on the links above to arrange your viewing. Tenancies at this property will be fully managed by a professional management company.

FleetMilne is a member of Client Money Protect, which is a client money protection scheme, and also a member of The Property Ombudsman which is a redress scheme. You can find out more details on the agent’s website or by contacting the agent directly.
